visual_review: Two overlapping socks as in the reference: back sock upper left, front sock lower right, each with a cuff band, straight leg, 45-degree foot and round toe; the pair shares the front sock's left edge and instep line.
omissions: Heel patches omitted: the 11-unit-wide feet leave no room for an enclosed patch 8 clear of the cuff and instep (tried: undersized hole plus internal-spacing failures).
